hypothesis: Replace the four redundant affine layout scalars with three unrestricted response coordinates, preserving the initial function and all other 85 scalars; test whether the changed optimization geometry improves all-seed fitting at the unchanged budget.

design.training: Exact saturation-v1 1152-event observed NAND training tape; identical bytes, order and full outcome likelihood for both arms. No additional examples, gold roles or participant-order labels.
design.initialization: Centered89 versus existing coordinate_encoder88. Same 85 nonlayout scalars and equal initial responses on the three legal identity masks. All real training token features must match initial order probabilities within 1e-14. No sign or zero-mean constraint; full legal-mask response class preserved. Keep actual initial tensors and response-equivalence receipts.
design.optimization: Same Adam settings and parameter-space gradient clipping; changing coordinates intentionally changes effective optimizer and clipping geometry. This is not an identical-gradient or matched-consumed-compute claim.
design.holdout: Fresh ordered fanout_cross4 and chain_shortcut5 event families. Novelty guard includes all bilingual/binding/saturation/centering schedules, ignoring edge direction and active-entity renaming while preserving event order. Same laws, four anchors, layouts and paired reversals; no outcome filtering. Words and training-withheld lexical-layout cells already opened.
design.retention: Opened bilingual-v1, lexical-v1, binding-v1, saturation-v1 and centering-v1. Original lexical, binding-factor, saturation-unsaturated and centering-centered forecasts are archived references. Preserve paired current-centered exact predictions too. No archived fits/forecasts are changed or recollected.
design.controls: Paired centered89 control must exactly reproduce archived centering initial/final fingerprints for all seeds; mismatch invalidates the experiment. Same canonical-prefix final-word mask/swap probes and separate evaluator-only native-action references. Historical GRU/additive results are context, not fresh-bank architecture comparators.
design.decision: Coordinate88 must pass unchanged per-cell, pair, probability, mask/swap criteria at every seed/law; observed training mean NLL<=.05, zero native/archived/paired exact regressions and no mean fresh NLL increase versus paired centered89. KEEP_LAYOUT_COORDINATES only if all pass, otherwise REVISE_COORDINATE_HYPOTHESIS. Individual adverse probability changes reported without a new veto. A pass closes only this bounded fitting/transfer question, not full G3.
design.publication: Publish source/protocol/recipe/all data hashes before fitting; publish all ten actual checkpoints before collection. Offline publication SHA arguments are attestations verified against GitHub outside the runner.
design.failure: One research fit/collection attempt with exclusive output directories. No retries, seed selection, extra fitting or early stopping. Collect all completed seeds including training-fit failures. Invalid or incomplete inventories stop. Synthetic invariant tests are labeled separately.
design.limits: Public same-team experiment, not independent scientific custody. Known binary physics, supplied identity resolution/token boundaries, two directed contact alternatives, full endpoint feedback and existing rank-one structure. Equal exposure/update budgets do not establish matched consumed compute. G3 stays open; no production promotion or G4 advance.
